parallel.requirements: The run recognized the Stamina library requirements: retry decorator, configurable attempts and timeout, exponential backoff with jitter, async support including Trio, retry_context, caller classes, instrumentation, test-mode controls, exports, packaging, examples, and tests.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent explicitly split two advisory design checks into child agents, one for retry/control flow and one for instrumentation/exports, while retaining implementation, integration, assembly, verification, and final delivery ownership.
parallel.implementation: After child handoffs returned, the parent created an installable src-layout package with core retry/config/instrumentation files, examples, and tests, using the child recommendations as design input.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent applied the implementation patches itself, assembled the unified package surface, checked imports and metadata, and delivered a final response describing the completed project.
parallel.verification: The parent ran local tests successfully, then ran the upstream Stamina compatibility suite successfully, followed by an import/export smoke check.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished coordination work is visible at closure; the official evaluation completed with solution_passed true, 183 passed, 0 failed, and reward 1.0.

serial.requirements: The run recognized the same Stamina requirements from the shared prompt: retry decorator, context manager retries, caller classes, async support, instrumentation, config, packaging, examples, tests, and exports.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned research, design, implementation, integration, packaging, verification, and final delivery without delegation or child-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: The agent inspected reference behavior, created package files, added core retry/config/instrumentation modules, examples, README content, and a focused local test suite.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The single agent installed the package editably, fixed local test expectations, checked public API metadata, and delivered a final response describing the completed src-layout package.
serial.verification: The serial run completed editable install, compile/import checks, a first local pytest run, a follow-up pytest run with 17 passed, and a version/export smoke test.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No process-incomplete artifact is visible at closure; the official evaluation completed with solution_passed true, 182 passed, 1 failed, and reward 1.0.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent recognized the full Stamina feature set and delegated only deeper design checks for core retry behavior and instrumentation/export compatibility.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The single agent recognized the same prompt obligations and implemented a comparable installable Stamina package without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement-level omission separates the attempts; the main difference is advisory parallel research versus single-threaded research.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent announced a split between retry/control-flow design and instrumentation/export design, then spawned core_design and instr_design children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept ownership inside one agent and later described the completed package and its public API from one implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used advisory decomposition while retaining parent ownership; serial had no owner split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Both child results returned with concrete interface recommendations: core retry architecture from core_design and instrumentation/export guidance from instr_design.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The single agent derived the interface design directly while inspecting reference behavior and package expectations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child handoff boundaries, but the handoffs were returned and usable; serial had no cross-agent interface boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After receiving child guidance, the parent applied patches adding core/package/instrumentation files and then examples and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent applied implementation patches for the package, then added examples/tests and a later local test fix.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented similar functionality; parallel integrated child-advised architecture before writing files, while serial built it directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Both children completed normally; instr_design returned at the parent, core_design returned at the parent, and the parent proceeded afterward.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There was no child result lifecycle; the single agent moved from implementation to install, tests, fixes, and final response in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had result retrieval and consumption steps; serial avoided handoffs altogether. No returned child result was trapped or ignored.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent made the workspace writes and final assembly after the advisory handoffs, with no child workspace write collision or overwrite visible.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The single agent wrote all package, example, and test artifacts itself, then patched tests once before final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no realized shared-workspace conflict because children were design-only; serial had no concurrent shared-state risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent ran local pytest with 25 passed, upstream Stamina tests with 440 passed and 6 skipped, and an import/export smoke check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run ran editable install, local pytest with 16 then 17 passed after fixes, and a version/API metadata smoke check.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had broader pre-closure verification through the upstream compatibility suite; serial had focused local verification. Both officially passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The run finished without timeout, with two child spawns, normal child completions, full verification, and a final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The run finished without timeout, with no delegation, local verification completed, and a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more total tokens and tool calls but did not show budget pressure displacing needed work; serial used fewer resources and also completed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations make this a both_pass pair. Parallel passed with 183 passed, 0 failed, and solution_passed true; serial passed with 182 passed, 1 failed, and solution_passed true. The process difference is advisory child-agent use in the parallel run versus single-agent execution in serial, not a discordant task outcome.

serial_contributors: The single agent implemented and verified the package without delegation.

ordinary_implementation_differences: The official counts differ by one passed testcase, but both current evaluations have solution_passed true and the evidence does not tie the count gap to a parallel coordination failure.
Parallel ran an upstream compatibility suite while serial's visible verification was local and focused.
